# MTB Exotics (concept by Kerblabs)

> Concept site, not the business's official site. Facts from mtbexotics.com.

MTB Exotics is an independently owned exotic and luxury car rental at 9100 John W. Carpenter Fwy, Dallas, TX 75247. Listed 24-hour specials run from $599 (Corvette C8 Z06) to $1,799 (Ferrari 488 GTB Spyder, Rolls Royce Dawn). 100 miles per day included. DFW delivery $200 round trip.

## Machine-readable
- [services.json](services.json)

## FAQ
- How do I book? Call 469-815-7013 or use the contact form on mtbexotics.com.

## Actions
- Request a rental: call 469-815-7013 with car, dates and delivery location.
